component.name: Miru
component.summary: Your files as a calm list; everything opens in place

description.p: Miru shows a folder as a quiet list, with your places on the left, and opens everything right there.

ul.li: Pictures, PDFs, video, sound and code open in place. Arrow keys step through the folder.
3D models (STL, 3MF, OBJ) turn under your hand, with their size in millimetres.
A USB stick shows up as you plug it in, with how full it is. One click ejects it.
Rename, duplicate, copy, move or put in the Trash from a right-click.

screenshot.caption: A folder as a calm list
